settings.name: activeAction
settings.title: Active action
settings.summary: A text value the game keeps for the current menu action.
settings.details: The registered default is empty. Its use is not documented.

settings.name: bg_aimSpreadMoveSpeedThreshold
settings.title: Movement spread threshold
settings.summary: The movement speed above which your aim spread grows.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 11.

settings.name: bg_bobAmplitudeDucked
settings.title: Crouch bob size
settings.summary: How much your view bobs while you move crouched.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.0075. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: bg_bobAmplitudeProne
settings.title: Prone bob size
settings.summary: How much your view bobs while you move prone.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.03. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: bg_bobAmplitudeStanding
settings.title: Standing bob size
settings.summary: How much your view bobs while you move standing.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.007. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: bg_bobMax
settings.title: Largest view bob
settings.summary: A limit on how far your view can bob.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 8. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: bg_fallDamageMaxHeight
settings.title: Full-damage fall height
settings.summary: The fall height at which fall damage reaches 100.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 480. Damage grows evenly from the minimum height up to this one, and it is also part of the server's system information.

settings.name: bg_fallDamageMinHeight
settings.title: No-damage fall height
settings.summary: The fall height below which you take no fall damage.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 256. It must stay below the full damage height or the game prints an error and applies no damage.

settings.name: bg_foliagesnd_fastinterval
settings.title: Fast foliage sound gap
settings.summary: A timing value for foliage sounds when you move fast.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 500 milliseconds. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: bg_foliagesnd_maxspeed
settings.title: Foliage sound maximum speed
settings.summary: A movement speed value for foliage sounds.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 180. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: bg_foliagesnd_minspeed
settings.title: Foliage sound minimum speed
settings.summary: A movement speed value for foliage sounds.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 40. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: bg_foliagesnd_resetinterval
settings.title: Foliage sound reset gap
settings.summary: A timing value for resetting foliage sounds.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 500 milliseconds. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: bg_foliagesnd_slowinterval
settings.title: Slow foliage sound gap
settings.summary: A timing value for foliage sounds when you move slowly.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 1,500 milliseconds. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: bg_ladder_yawcap
settings.title: Ladder turn limit
settings.summary: How far, in degrees, you can turn either side of a ladder while climbing.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 100 degrees.

settings.name: bg_prone_yawcap
settings.title: Prone turn limit
settings.summary: How far, in degrees, you can turn while prone.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 85 degrees.

settings.name: bg_swingSpeed
settings.title: Torso swing speed
settings.summary: How fast a character's torso turns to follow where it looks.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.2. When the server's CoD2x level is 3 or higher, the game ignores it and uses 1, so characters always match their view angles.

settings.name: cg_blood
settings.title: Blood effects
settings.summary: Shows blood when players are hit.
settings.details: The game's menu calls this Show Blood. It is only visual, and guides report no real effect on performance. Newer zPAM versions also use it to show where a hit landed.

settings.name: cg_brass
settings.title: Shell casings
settings.summary: Shows spent cartridges flying out of weapons.
settings.details: Turning it off can improve frame rate slightly while firing, according to TweakGuide and another guide. It does not change how weapons work.

settings.name: cg_centerPrintY
settings.title: Centre message height
settings.summary: How high or low centre messages appear.
settings.details: From -10,000 to 10,000, and -60 by default.

settings.name: cg_centertime
settings.title: Centre message time
settings.summary: How many seconds centre messages stay on screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 5 seconds.

settings.name: cg_chatHeight
settings.title: Chat lines on screen
settings.summary: How many chat lines stay on screen at once.
settings.details: It runs from 0 to 8 lines, and 8 is the default. Messages also fade after the chat time set separately.

settings.name: cg_chatTime
settings.title: Chat duration
settings.summary: How long chat messages stay on screen.
settings.details: The value is in milliseconds, from 0 to 60,000, and 12,000 by default. The line limit can remove older messages sooner.

settings.name: cg_connectionIconSize
settings.title: Connection icon size
settings.summary: How large the connection-problem icon is; 0 hides it.
settings.details: From 0 to 100, and 0 by default.

settings.name: cg_constantSizeHeadIcons
settings.title: Constant-size head icons
settings.summary: Keeps head icons the same size at any distance.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: cg_crosshairAlpha
settings.title: Crosshair opacity
settings.summary: How solid the crosshair is.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

settings.name: cg_crosshairAlphaMin
settings.title: Crosshair minimum opacity
settings.summary: The faintest the crosshair gets.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

settings.name: cg_crosshairDynamic
settings.title: Crosshair follows spread
settings.summary: Makes the crosshair size follow your weapon spread.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. Published pro configs show it off.

settings.name: cg_crosshairEnemyColor
settings.title: Crosshair over enemies
settings.summary: Changes the crosshair's colour when it is over an enemy.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: cg_cursorHints
settings.title: Use-hint style
settings.summary: How the on-screen use hints look.
settings.details: TweakGuide lists 0 as none, 1 as a fast pulse, 2 as a slow pulse and 3 as static. The game's default is 4, which looks the same as 3.

settings.name: cg_debugBullets
settings.title: Bullet trace debug
settings.summary: Draws bullet traces and impact points, for diagnosing hit registration.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. CoD2x only.

settings.name: cg_debugevents
settings.title: Event debug
settings.summary: Prints game events for debugging.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: cg_debugposition
settings.title: Position debug
settings.summary: Prints player positions for debugging.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: cg_descriptiveText
settings.title: Descriptive hint text
settings.summary: Shows descriptive text in on-screen hints.
settings.details: On by default.

settings.name: cg_draw2D
settings.title: Draw the 2D layer
settings.summary: Whether the game draws the HUD layer.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: cg_drawBreathHint
settings.title: Breath hint
settings.summary: Shows the 'hold breath' hint when you are scoped.
settings.details: On by default.

settings.name: cg_drawCompass
settings.title: Show compass
settings.summary: Shows the compass, objectives and friendly markers.
settings.details: CoD2x only. Turning it off hides the compass and the CoD2x drawing tied to it. On by default. Servers can still affect what the match HUD shows.

settings.name: cg_drawCrosshair
settings.title: Show crosshair
settings.summary: Shows the crosshair in the middle of the screen.
settings.details: The game's menu calls this Enable Crosshair. It controls the standard crosshair only; scoped weapons draw their own reticle.

settings.name: cg_drawCrosshairNames
settings.title: Show player names
settings.summary: Shows a player's name when your crosshair is on them.
settings.details: On by default. Servers using ePAM 1.02 force it on for every player.

settings.name: cg_drawCrosshairNamesPosX
settings.title: Name left-right position
settings.summary: Where the name under your crosshair sits, from the left.
settings.details: From 0 to 640, and 300 by default.

settings.name: cg_drawCrosshairNamesPosY
settings.title: Name up-down position
settings.summary: Where the name under your crosshair sits, from the top.
settings.details: From 0 to 480, and 180 by default.

settings.name: cg_drawFPS
settings.title: Show frame rate
settings.summary: Shows a frame rate counter in the corner while you play.
settings.details: Simple shows frames per second, with the lowest and highest recent values and a figure for how much they vary. Verbose adds counts of triangles drawn and texture memory in use. Time shows milliseconds per frame instead, with the same extra counts. It averages the last 32 frames and is not a benchmark.

settings.name: cg_drawGameMessages
settings.title: Game messages
settings.summary: Shows messages from the game on screen.
settings.details: On by default.

settings.name: cg_drawGun
settings.title: Draw your weapon
settings.summary: Whether your first-person weapon is drawn.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. A PunkBuster stock list and WWCL's old rules required it on.

settings.name: cg_drawHealth
settings.title: Draw a health bar
settings.summary: Shows a health bar, which the game does not normally show.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. WWCL's old rules required it off.

settings.name: cg_drawLagometer
settings.title: Show connection graph
settings.summary: Shows a small graph that tracks how steadily updates arrive from the server.
settings.details: One trace shows how old your newest update is and the other shows your ping, marking updates that were lost. It appears only when you are connected to another player's server. It helps you read your connection and does not fix it.

settings.name: cg_drawMantleHint
settings.title: Mantle hint
settings.summary: Shows the prompt that tells you when you can climb over something.
settings.details: On by default. Turning it off hides the grey prompt, which is only visual.

settings.name: cg_drawMaterial
settings.title: Draw a named material
settings.summary: A developer switch that draws a named material on screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: cg_drawRadar
settings.title: Spectator radar
settings.summary: Draws a radar of every player, but only for spectators, demos or when cheats are on.
settings.details: CoD2x only, and not a player aid: the radar is drawn only for spectators, while a demo plays or when cheats are on, and only if a radar map image has been set. It is off by default and not saved.

settings.name: cg_drawScriptUsage
settings.title: Show script usage
settings.summary: Shows script usage information.
settings.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here.

settings.name: cg_drawSnapshot
settings.title: Show update info
settings.summary: Shows technical information about the updates your game receives.
settings.details: A diagnostic overlay, off by default.

settings.name: cg_drawSoundOverlay
settings.title: Sound debug overlay
settings.summary: Shows a sound debugging overlay.
settings.details: Choices are None, 3D, Stream and 2D. A developer aid.

settings.name: cg_drawSpectatedPlayerName
settings.title: Spectated player's name
settings.summary: Shows who you are watching while you spectate.
settings.details: CoD2x only. It draws a 'following' line with the player's name at the top centre while you spectate. On by default.

settings.name: cg_drawTurretCrosshair
settings.title: Turret crosshair
settings.summary: Shows the crosshair while you use a turret.
settings.details: On by default. ePAM 1.02 forced it on for every player.

settings.name: cg_dumpAnims
settings.title: Client animation dump
settings.summary: Dumps an entity's animations for debugging.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: cg_errordecay
settings.title: Prediction smoothing
settings.summary: How fast your game smooths out corrections to your predicted position.
settings.details: The default is 100. zPAM sets it to 100 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it. ESL's old PunkBuster list also required 100.

settings.name: cg_footsteps
settings.title: Footstep sounds
settings.summary: Whether footstep sounds and effects play.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: cg_fov
settings.title: Field of view
settings.summary: How wide your view is.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 80 degrees for a 4:3 screen and the game widens it for wider screens. ESL's old PunkBuster list and WWCL's old rules required exactly 80. Whether a config file can set it is untested, so nothing here offers it.

settings.name: cg_fovMin
settings.title: Smallest field of view
settings.summary: The lowest the final field of view may go.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 10 degrees.

settings.name: cg_fovScale
settings.title: Field of view scale
settings.summary: A multiplier applied to the final field of view.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 1, from 0.2 to 2. Because mouse speed scales with the original value, a scale above 1 also raises mouse speed.

settings.name: cg_gameBoldMessageWidth
settings.title: Bold message width
settings.summary: How many characters wide bold game messages are.
settings.details: From 20 to 256, and 60 by default.

settings.name: cg_gameMessageWidth
settings.title: Message width
settings.summary: How many characters wide game messages are.
settings.details: From 20 to 256, and 70 by default.

settings.name: cg_gun_move_f
settings.title: Weapon move forward
settings.summary: Moves where your first-person weapon sits on the screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.

settings.name: cg_gun_move_minspeed
settings.title: Weapon move minimum speed
settings.summary: Moves where your first-person weapon sits on the screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.

settings.name: cg_gun_move_r
settings.title: Weapon move right
settings.summary: Moves where your first-person weapon sits on the screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.

settings.name: cg_gun_move_rate
settings.title: Weapon move rate
settings.summary: Moves where your first-person weapon sits on the screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.

settings.name: cg_gun_move_u
settings.title: Weapon move up
settings.summary: Moves where your first-person weapon sits on the screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.

settings.name: cg_gun_ofs_f
settings.title: Weapon offset forward
settings.summary: Moves where your first-person weapon sits on the screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.

settings.name: cg_gun_ofs_r
settings.title: Weapon offset right
settings.summary: Moves where your first-person weapon sits on the screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.

settings.name: cg_gun_ofs_u
settings.title: Weapon offset up
settings.summary: Moves where your first-person weapon sits on the screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.

settings.name: cg_gun_x
settings.title: Weapon left-right offset
settings.summary: Moves where your first-person weapon sits on the screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0. A PunkBuster stock list required 0.

settings.name: cg_gun_y
settings.title: Weapon forward offset
settings.summary: Moves where your first-person weapon sits on the screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.

settings.name: cg_gun_z
settings.title: Weapon up-down offset
settings.summary: Moves where your first-person weapon sits on the screen.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.

settings.name: cg_headIconMinScreenRadius
settings.title: Head icon minimum size
settings.summary: The smallest size a head icon gets on screen.
settings.details: From 0 to 1, and 0.02 by default.

settings.name: cg_hintFadeTime
settings.title: Hint hold time
settings.summary: How many milliseconds a hint stays before it fades.
settings.details: From 0 upward, and 100 by default. A guide describes seconds, but the game's registration is in milliseconds. zPAM sets it to 100 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudChatPosition
settings.title: Chat position
settings.summary: Where chat appears on the screen, as two numbers.
settings.details: Left and top positions from 0 to 640, 5 and 150 by default.

settings.name: cg_hudCompassMaxRange
settings.title: Compass range
settings.summary: How far away players and objects show on the compass.
settings.details: In game units, 1,500 by default. zPAM sets it to 1,500 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudCompassMinRadius
settings.title: Compass minimum radius
settings.summary: The smallest radius the compass draws markers at.
settings.details: In game units, 0 by default. zPAM sets it to 0 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudCompassMinRange
settings.title: Compass minimum range
settings.summary: The closest range the compass draws markers for.
settings.details: In game units, 0 by default. zPAM sets it to 0 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudCompassOffsetX
settings.title: Compass left-right shift
settings.summary: Moves the compass sideways on the screen.
settings.details: CoD2x only. It runs from -640 to 640, and 0 is the usual position.

settings.name: cg_hudCompassOffsetY
settings.title: Compass up-down shift
settings.summary: Moves the compass up or down on the screen.
settings.details: CoD2x only. It runs from -480 to 480, and 0 is the usual position.

settings.name: cg_hudCompassSize
settings.title: Compass size
settings.summary: How large the compass is; 0 hides it.
settings.details: A multiplier, 1 by default. A PunkBuster stock list allowed 0.5 to 2, and published configs use 1 to 1.2.

settings.name: cg_hudCompassSoundPingFadeTime
settings.title: Compass sound fade
settings.summary: How many seconds a sound marker lingers on the compass.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 2 seconds, and zPAM sets it to 2 for every player.

settings.name: cg_hudCompassSpringyPointers
settings.title: Springy compass pointers
settings.summary: Makes compass pointers move with a springy motion.
settings.details: Off by default. zPAM sets it to off for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudDamageIconHeight
settings.title: Damage indicator height
settings.summary: How tall the damage direction indicator is.
settings.details: The default is 64. zPAM sets it to 64 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudDamageIconInScope
settings.title: Damage indicator while scoped
settings.summary: Whether the damage direction indicator shows while you look through a scope.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. zPAM sets it to on for every player, while ESL's old PunkBuster list required it off.

settings.name: cg_hudDamageIconOffset
settings.title: Damage indicator distance
settings.summary: How far from the centre the damage direction indicator sits.
settings.details: The default is 128. zPAM sets it to 128 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudDamageIconTime
settings.title: Damage indicator time
settings.summary: How long the damage direction indicator stays on screen, in milliseconds.
settings.details: The default is 2,000 milliseconds. zPAM sets it to 2,000 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudDamageIconWidth
settings.title: Damage indicator width
settings.summary: How wide the damage direction indicator is.
settings.details: The default is 128. zPAM sets it to 128 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadeIconHeight
settings.title: Grenade icon height
settings.summary: How tall the incoming-grenade icon is.
settings.details: The default is 25. zPAM sets it to 25 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadeIconInScope
settings.title: Grenade icon while scoped
settings.summary: Whether the incoming-grenade icon shows while you look through a scope.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. zPAM sets it to on for every player.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadeIconMaxHeight
settings.title: Grenade icon maximum height
settings.summary: The tallest the incoming-grenade icon can get.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 104.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadeIconMaxRange
settings.title: Grenade icon range
settings.summary: How far away an incoming grenade still shows an icon.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 250 game units.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadeIconOffset
settings.title: Grenade icon distance
settings.summary: How far from the centre the incoming-grenade icon sits.
settings.details: The default is 50. zPAM sets it to 50 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadeIconWidth
settings.title: Grenade icon width
settings.summary: How wide the incoming-grenade icon is.
settings.details: The default is 25. zPAM sets it to 25 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadePointerHeight
settings.title: Grenade pointer height
settings.summary: How tall the incoming-grenade pointer is.
settings.details: The default is 12. zPAM sets it to 12 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadePointerPivot
settings.title: Grenade pointer pivot
settings.summary: The point the incoming-grenade pointer turns around.
settings.details: Two numbers, 12 and 27 by default. zPAM sets it to 12 27 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadePointerPulseFreq
settings.title: Grenade pointer pulse speed
settings.summary: How fast the incoming-grenade pointer pulses.
settings.details: From 0.1 to 50, and 1.7 by default.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadePointerPulseMax
settings.title: Grenade pointer pulse maximum
settings.summary: How large the incoming-grenade pointer pulse gets.
settings.details: From 0 to 3, and 1.85 by default.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadePointerPulseMin
settings.title: Grenade pointer pulse minimum
settings.summary: How small the incoming-grenade pointer pulse gets.
settings.details: From -3 to 1, and 0.3 by default.

settings.name: cg_hudGrenadePointerWidth
settings.title: Grenade pointer width
settings.summary: How wide the incoming-grenade pointer is.
settings.details: The default is 25. zPAM sets it to 25 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudObjectiveMaxRange
settings.title: Objective icon range
settings.summary: How far away objective icons still show.
settings.details: The default is 2,048. zPAM sets it to 2,048 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudObjectiveMinAlpha
settings.title: Objective icon opacity
settings.summary: The faintest an objective icon gets.
settings.details: The default is 1. zPAM sets it to 1 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudObjectiveMinHeight
settings.title: Objective icon height
settings.summary: The lowest height objective icons are drawn at.
settings.details: The default is -70. zPAM sets it to -70 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_hudProneY
settings.title: Prone indicator position
settings.summary: How high or low the prone indicator sits on the screen.
settings.details: From -10,000 to 10,000, and -160 by default.

settings.name: cg_hudRadarColor
settings.title: Radar tint colour
settings.summary: The tint of the radar map image.
settings.details: CoD2x only, and part of the spectator radar, which is drawn only for spectators, demos or when cheats are on.

settings.name: cg_hudRadarEntityOffsetX
settings.title: Radar player left-right shift
settings.summary: Shifts players left or right on the radar.
settings.details: CoD2x only, and part of the spectator radar, which is drawn only for spectators, demos or when cheats are on. The game fills it in from the map's radar file or when you calibrate the radar.

settings.name: cg_hudRadarEntityOffsetY
settings.title: Radar player up-down shift
settings.summary: Shifts players up or down on the radar.
settings.details: CoD2x only, and part of the spectator radar, which is drawn only for spectators, demos or when cheats are on. The game fills it in from the map's radar file or when you calibrate the radar.

settings.name: cg_hudRadarEntityScale
settings.title: Radar player scale
settings.summary: Scales the positions of players on the radar.

settings.name: cg_hudSayPosition

settings.name: cg_hudStanceFlash

settings.name: cg_hudStanceHintPrints

settings.details: Off by default.

settings.name: cg_marks

settings.details: Turning it off can improve frame rate in heavy fighting, according to TweakGuide and another guide. Marks are only visual and do not change hit registration.

settings.name: cg_marksLimit
settings.title: Bullet mark limit
settings.summary: The most bullet and explosion marks kept on screen at once.
settings.details: From 0 to 1,024, and 1,024 by default. Fewer marks can ease heavy fights. It only matters while Bullet marks is on.

settings.name: cg_nopredict

settings.name: cg_noTaunt

settings.details: Off by default.

settings.name: cg_predictItems
settings.title: Predict item pickups

settings.details: On by default, and shared with the server as player information.

settings.name: cg_scoreboardBannerHeight

settings.details: From 1 to 100, and 24 by default.

settings.name: cg_scoreboardItemHeight

settings.details: From 1 to 100, and 18 by default. zPAM replaces the scoreboard menu.

settings.name: cg_scoreboardScrollStep

settings.details: From 1 to 8, and 3 by default.

settings.name: cg_scriptIconSize

settings.details: From 0 to 100, and 0 by default.

settings.name: cg_showmiss

settings.details: A developer aid from 0 to 2, off by default.

settings.name: cg_subtitleCharHeight

settings.details: From 1 to 480, and 12 by default.

settings.name: cg_subtitleMinTime

settings.details: The default is 3 seconds.

settings.name: cg_subtitlePosX

settings.details: From 0 to 640, and 120 by default.

settings.name: cg_subtitlePosY

settings.details: From 0 to 480, and 400 by default.

settings.name: cg_subtitles

settings.details: Only sounds that come with subtitle text can show one. Default is on.

settings.name: cg_subtitleWidthStandard

settings.details: From 20 to 256, and 80 by default.

settings.details: Off by default.

settings.name: cg_thirdPerson
settings.title: Third-person camera
settings.summary: Shows the game from behind your player.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: cg_thirdPersonAngle
settings.title: Third-person angle

settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.

settings.name: cg_thirdPersonMode

settings.summary: A CoD2x variant of the third-person camera.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. Mode 1 orbits the player without checking for walls. CoD2x only.

settings.name: cg_thirdPersonRange
settings.title: Third-person distance
settings.summary: How far behind you the third-person camera sits.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 120.

settings.name: cg_tracerchance

settings.summary: How often a bullet shows a tracer.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.4. zPAM sets it to 1 for every player.

settings.name: cg_tracerlength
settings.title: Tracer length
settings.summary: How long bullet tracers are.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 160. zPAM sets it to 1,000 for every player.

settings.name: cg_tracerScale
settings.title: Tracer scale
settings.summary: A scale for distant bullet tracers.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 50.

settings.name: cg_tracerScaleDistRange
settings.title: Tracer scale range
settings.summary: A distance range for scaling distant tracers.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 25,000.

settings.name: cg_tracerScaleMinDist
settings.title: Tracer scale start
settings.summary: The distance where tracers start to scale.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 5,000.

settings.name: cg_tracerSpeed
settings.title: Tracer speed
settings.summary: How fast bullet tracers travel.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 4,500. zPAM sets it to 20,000 for every player.

settings.name: cg_tracerwidth
settings.title: Tracer width
settings.summary: How wide bullet tracers are.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.8. zPAM sets it to 1 for every player.

settings.name: cg_viewsize
settings.title: View size
settings.summary: How much of the screen the 3D view fills.
settings.details: A percentage from 30 to 100, and 100 by default. Its effect in CoD2 is inferred from its Quake heritage. ESL's old PunkBuster list required 100. zPAM sets it to 100 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

settings.name: cg_voiceIconSize
settings.title: Voice icon size
settings.summary: How large the voice chat icon is; 0 hides it.
settings.details: From 0 to 100, and 0 by default.

settings.name: cg_voiceSpriteTime
settings.title: Voice sprite time
settings.summary: How many milliseconds a voice sprite stays on screen.
settings.details: From 0 to 60,000, and 6,000 by default.

settings.name: cg_weaponCycleDelay
settings.title: Weapon cycle delay
settings.summary: A delay, in milliseconds, between weapon-cycle key presses.
settings.details: 0 by default. zPAM briefly sets it to 200 to prevent the fast-reload double-scroll trick, then back to 0.

settings.name: cg_weaponleftbone
settings.title: Left weapon bone
settings.summary: The model tag the left-hand weapon attaches to.
settings.details: The default is the left weapon tag.

settings.name: cg_weaponrightbone
settings.title: Right weapon bone
settings.summary: The model tag the right-hand weapon attaches to.
settings.details: The default is the right weapon tag.

settings.name: cg_youInKillCamSize
settings.title: Kill-cam marker size
settings.summary: How large the 'you' marker is in the kill cam.
settings.details: From 0 to 100, and 6 by default.

settings.name: cl_allowDownload
settings.title: Download server content
settings.summary: Lets the game download maps and mods from the server you join.
settings.details: The game's menu calls this Allow Downloading. Downloads happen while you connect, and the server also has to allow them. With it off you will not get files a server needs.

settings.name: cl_analog_attack_threshold
settings.title: Controller fire point
settings.summary: How far a controller trigger must be pressed to fire.
settings.details: A fraction from 0.0001 to 1, 0.8 by default. This version of the game only registers it and never reads the value.

settings.name: cl_anglespeedkey
settings.title: Keyboard turn boost
settings.summary: How much faster the look and turn keys work while the speed key is held.
settings.details: A multiplier on the keyboard look and turn speeds, 1.5 by default. It does not affect the mouse.

settings.name: cl_anonymous
settings.title: Anonymous login
settings.summary: Whether you hide your identity when joining servers.
settings.details: The game protects this setting from writes, so it can't be changed from here.

settings.name: cl_avidemo
settings.title: Capture video frames
settings.summary: Saves every frame as a picture file so you can assemble a video.
settings.details: Any number above 0 starts the capture at that many frames per second, which can slow the computer a great deal; 0 stops it. zPAM sets it back to 0 when you join a team.

settings.name: cl_bypassMouseInput
settings.title: Mouse works in menus
settings.summary: Keeps the mouse controlling your view even while a menu is open.
settings.details: Leave it off in normal play: with it on, your view turns while you move around menus. Some tools and zPAM's mouse menu use it.

settings.name: cl_cod2x_version
settings.title: CoD2x build name
settings.summary: The CoD2x build this game reports.
settings.details: The game fills this in itself and treats it as read-only.

settings.name: cl_connectTimeout
settings.title: Connection attempt time
settings.summary: How many seconds the game keeps trying to connect to a server.
settings.details: From 0 to 3,600 seconds, 200 by default.

settings.name: cl_demoAutoRecordName
settings.title: Automatic demo name
settings.summary: The file name a server mod gave your game for an automatic demo recording.
settings.details: Set only by a server mod, and protected from changes here. While it is set, stopping the recording is ignored.

settings.name: cl_demoAutoRecordUploadTimeout
settings.title: Demo upload time limit
settings.summary: How many seconds an automatic demo upload may take before it gives up.
settings.details: From 10 to 600 seconds, 60 by default. It applies only if a server mod asks your game to upload demos.

settings.name: cl_demoAutoRecordUploadUrl
settings.title: Automatic demo upload address
settings.summary: The web address a server mod told your game to upload automatic demos to.
settings.details: Set only by a server mod, and protected from changes here.

settings.name: cl_forceavidemo
settings.title: Force frame capture
settings.summary: Forces the video frame capture to run.
settings.details: Related to Capture video frames. zPAM sets it back to 0 when you join a team.

settings.name: cl_freelook
settings.title: Look with the mouse
settings.summary: Lets moving the mouse up and down tilt your view.
settings.details: With it off, moving the mouse forward and back walks you instead of tilting the view, unless the mouse-look key is held. The game's menu calls it Free Look. zPAM servers set it back to on when you join a team.

settings.name: cl_freezeDemo
settings.title: Freeze demo playback
settings.summary: Pauses playback of a recorded demo.
settings.details: A developer aid. It is not saved.

settings.name: cl_hwid2
settings.title: Hardware ID
settings.summary: A long identity code CoD2x servers use to recognise your computer.
settings.details: The game builds it itself and treats it as read-only. CoD2x servers use it for bans in place of PunkBuster IDs, and reject players who send no valid one. Never edit it.

settings.name: cl_ingame
settings.title: In a game
settings.summary: Whether you are in a game right now.
settings.details: The game keeps this up to date itself and treats it as read-only.

settings.name: cl_masterPort
settings.title: Second master port
settings.summary: The network port used to reach the second master server.
settings.details: From 1 to 65,535, 20710 by default. Current upstream CoD2x no longer registers it, but this version of the game still reads it.

settings.name: cl_masterServer
settings.title: Second master server
settings.summary: The address of the second master server the game asks for the server list.
settings.details: The CoD2x build asks cod2master.activision.com first and then the address here, master.cod2x.me by default, on the port set separately. Current upstream CoD2x no longer registers it, but this version of the game still reads it.

settings.name: cl_maxpackets
settings.title: Updates you send
settings.summary: The most movement updates your game sends the server each second.
settings.details: This is an upper limit, not a promise of that many packets per second. The game's connection-speed step sets it to 30 whenever the connection speed is 5,000 or more, and the in-game Connection menu is expected to run that step. Servers using CoD2x competitive rules enforce 125; zPAM 3 servers on stock CoD2 expect 100.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

settings.name: cl_maxPing
settings.title: Server list ping wait
settings.summary: How long the server list waits for a server's ping reply before it shows the waiting time instead of 0.
settings.details: In milliseconds, 800 by default, and never treated as less than 100. A host's join ping limit is a different, server-side setting. This is the game's own server list only.

settings.name: cl_motdString
settings.title: Received server message
settings.summary: The server's message of the day, as the game last received it.
settings.details: The game fills this in itself and treats it as read-only.

settings.name: cl_mouseAccel
settings.title: Mouse acceleration
settings.summary: Turns your view farther the faster you move the mouse; 0 turns this off.
settings.details: The game adds this number, multiplied by how many mouse counts arrive each millisecond, to your mouse speed. For example 0.04 at 31 counts per millisecond adds 1.24. Zero is the default and keeps every turn the same size however fast your hand moves. zPAM's mouse menu offers 0 and 0.01 to 0.04.

settings.name: cl_nodelta
settings.title: Turn off update compression
settings.summary: A network debugging aid that makes the server send full updates instead of compact ones.
settings.details: Not for normal play: every update gets larger. It is not saved.

settings.name: cl_noprint
settings.title: Silence console messages
settings.summary: Stops the game printing messages to the console.
settings.details: It is not saved.

settings.name: cl_packetdup
settings.title: Repeat recent movement
settings.summary: How many extra copies of your recent movement go into each packet you send.
settings.details: The extra copies help when packets are lost, at the price of a little more data. Repeating does not reduce delay. The game's connection-speed step sets this to 1 whenever the connection speed is 5,000 or more.

settings.name: cl_paused
settings.title: Game paused
settings.summary: Whether the game is paused.
settings.details: The game keeps this up to date itself and treats it as read-only. Some players bind a key to toggle it.

settings.name: cl_pitchspeed
settings.title: Keyboard look speed
settings.summary: How fast the arrow-style look keys tilt your view up and down.
settings.details: In degrees per second, 140 by default. It affects only the keys bound to look up and look down, not the mouse. zPAM sets it to 140 when you join a team, and ESL's old PunkBuster list required 140.

settings.name: cl_profileTextHeight
settings.title: Profile text height
settings.summary: How tall the text is in the profile screens.
settings.details: From 1 to 100, and 16 by default. The research labels it a debugging value.

settings.name: cl_punkbuster
settings.title: PunkBuster (your game)
settings.summary: Whether the PunkBuster anti-cheat is switched on for your game.
settings.details: The game's menu shows it as PunkBuster, and the game protects it from changes here. This version of the game cannot show that a working PunkBuster service exists, and CoD2x does not support PunkBuster. League rules disagree: ScrimBase wants it on, while FPSChallenge and the 2026 Polish championship want it off.

settings.name: cl_serverStatusResendTime
settings.title: Server status retry time
settings.summary: How many milliseconds the game waits before asking a server for its status again.
settings.details: From 0 to 3,600 milliseconds, 750 by default.

settings.name: cl_showmouserate
settings.title: Show mouse rate
settings.summary: Prints your mouse update rate and effective mouse speed to the console while you move the mouse.
settings.details: A diagnostic: each line shows mouse counts per millisecond and the mouse speed the game ends up using, including Mouse acceleration and zooming. It floods the console, so use it only briefly.

settings.name: cl_shownet
settings.title: Show network debug
settings.summary: Prints network debugging information to the console.
settings.details: Levels run from -2 to 4, and 0 is off. It prints a lot of text, which can lower frame rate. For developers.

settings.name: cl_shownuments
settings.title: Entity debug switch
settings.summary: A developer switch the game registers; its name suggests entity counts.
settings.details: No effect is documented for it. It is not saved.

settings.name: cl_showSend
settings.title: Show sent packets
settings.summary: Prints a line for each packet your game sends.
settings.details: A developer aid for seeing how your update rate and frame rate batch together. It floods the console.

settings.name: cl_showServerCommands
settings.title: Show server commands
settings.summary: Prints the commands the server sends to your game.
settings.details: A developer aid. It is not saved.

settings.name: cl_showTimeDelta
settings.title: Show server time offset
settings.summary: Prints how far your game's clock is from the server's.
settings.details: A developer aid. It is not saved.

settings.name: cl_stanceHoldTime
settings.title: Stance hold time
settings.summary: How many milliseconds a stance key must be held for the hold-style stance change.
settings.details: From 0 to 1,000 milliseconds, 300 by default. This version of the game only registers it and never reads the value.

settings.name: cl_talking
settings.title: Sending voice now
settings.summary: Whether you are sending voice chat right now.
settings.details: The game keeps this up to date itself.

settings.name: cl_timeout
settings.title: Dropped connection time
settings.summary: How many seconds without any data from the server before your game disconnects.
settings.details: From 0 to 3,600 seconds, 200 by default. Rarely worth changing.

settings.name: cl_voice
settings.title: Receive voice chat
settings.summary: Lets other players' voice chat reach you.
settings.details: The server only sends you voice if your connection speed is 5,000 or more. Voice also depends on the server turning it on. The game's menu calls this Voice Chat.

settings.name: cl_wwwDownload
settings.title: Redirected downloads
settings.summary: Lets the game fetch server files from a web address the server names.
settings.details: The setting is shared with the server as player information, and the server only uses a redirect if it has one set up.

settings.name: cl_yawspeed
settings.title: Keyboard turn speed
settings.summary: How fast the turn-left and turn-right keys swing your view.
settings.details: In degrees per second, 140 by default. It affects only the keys bound to turn left and turn right, not the mouse. zPAM sets it to 140 when you join a team, and ESL's old PunkBuster list required 140.

settings.name: com_animCheck
settings.title: Animation check
settings.summary: A developer switch for checking animations.
settings.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here.

settings.name: com_errorMessage
settings.title: Last error message
settings.summary: The text of the last error the game showed.
settings.details: The game fills this in itself and treats it as read-only. It is not a personal preference.

settings.name: com_errorTitle
settings.title: Last error title
settings.summary: The title of the last error the game showed.
settings.details: The game fills this in itself and treats it as read-only. It is not a personal preference.

settings.name: com_expectedHunkUsage
settings.title: Expected memory use
settings.summary: A hint of the main memory the current map is expected to need.
settings.details: The game treats this as read-only and sets it itself.

settings.name: com_freezeWatch
settings.title: Freeze watchdog
settings.summary: Offers to save a crash report when the game stops responding.
settings.details: CoD2x only, on by default. It checks every second and shows a 'has frozen' dialog after about 12 seconds without a heartbeat.

settings.name: com_hunkMegs
settings.title: Game memory
settings.summary: How many megabytes the game reserves for its main memory.
settings.details: Stock allows 1 to 512 with 160 by default. CoD2x pins it to 512. It is latched, so a change applies after the game restarts.

settings.name: com_introPlayed
settings.title: Skip intro movies
settings.summary: Skips the opening publisher movies when set.
settings.details: Set to 1 to skip them. A guide suggests setting it on the launch line.

settings.name: com_maxfps
settings.title: Frame rate cap
settings.summary: The most frames per second the game will draw.
settings.details: The game turns the cap into whole milliseconds per frame (1000 divided by the cap, rounded down), so only some caps really differ, and 251 to 333 all run at the same rate. Because movement is calculated once per frame, the cap also changes jump height and fall damage, and 333 is commonly reported to jump highest. Servers using CoD2x competitive rules keep it between 125 and 250 and reset anything outside to 250; several league rule texts forbid 333.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

settings.name: com_maxfps_limit
settings.title: Legacy frame cap switch
settings.summary: The older CoD2x switch servers used to limit frame rates to 125 to 250.
settings.details: Competitive rules now use the competitive rules switch instead, and the CoD2x README still describes this older one. This version of the game still registers it and the server sets it, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: com_playerProfile
settings.title: Active profile name
settings.summary: The name of the profile the game is using.
settings.details: The game treats this as read-only and sets it itself. It comes from the active profile file when the game starts.

settings.name: com_recommendedSet
settings.title: System check done
settings.summary: Marks that the game's automatic system check has run.
settings.details: Present in saved configs. Leave it alone.

settings.name: com_statmon
settings.title: Stat monitor
settings.summary: A developer switch for a statistics monitor.
settings.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here.

settings.name: com_writeConfig
settings.title: Save game config changes
settings.summary: Lets CoD2x write changes to your config file as you play.
settings.details: CoD2x only, on by default. With it off, changes made in game are not saved, although the change to this setting itself is. Config Studio stays read-only while the game runs either way.

settings.name: con_boldgamemessagetime
settings.title: Bold message time
settings.summary: How many seconds bold game messages stay on screen.
settings.details: The default is 8 seconds.

settings.name: con_gamemessagetime
settings.title: Message time
settings.summary: How many seconds game messages stay on screen.
settings.details: The default is 5 seconds.

settings.name: con_inputBoxColor
settings.title: Console input colour
settings.summary: The colour of the console's input box.
settings.details: Four numbers from 0 to 1 for red, green, blue and opacity.

settings.name: con_inputHintBoxColor
settings.title: Console hint colour
settings.summary: The colour of the console's hint box.
settings.details: Four numbers from 0 to 1 for red, green, blue and opacity.

settings.name: con_minicon
settings.title: Mini console
settings.summary: Shows recent console text on the main screen.
settings.details: Off by default. The mini console's lines and time are set separately.

settings.name: con_miniconlines
settings.title: Mini console lines
settings.summary: How many lines the mini console shows.
settings.details: From 0 to 100, and 5 by default.

settings.name: con_minicontime
settings.title: Mini console time
settings.summary: How many seconds mini console text stays on screen.
settings.details: The default is 4 seconds.

settings.name: con_outputBarColor
settings.title: Console output bar colour
settings.summary: The colour of the console output bar.
settings.details: Four numbers from 0 to 1 for red, green, blue and opacity.

settings.name: con_outputSliderColor
settings.title: Console slider colour
settings.summary: The colour of the console output slider.
settings.details: Four numbers from 0 to 1 for red, green, blue and opacity.

settings.name: con_outputWindowColor
settings.title: Console window colour
settings.summary: The colour of the console output window.
settings.details: Four numbers from 0 to 1 for red, green, blue and opacity.

settings.name: con_printDoubleColors
settings.title: Double colour codes
settings.summary: Lets doubled colour codes show in the killfeed and console.
settings.details: CoD2x only. With it off, doubled colour codes are removed from console and killfeed text. On by default.

settings.name: con_restricted
settings.title: Restrict the console
settings.summary: Requires an extra key held down to open the in-game console.
settings.details: The game's menu calls this Enable Console and shows it the other way round: Yes is 0 and No is 1. With it on, the console does not open from the console key alone.

settings.name: dedicated
settings.title: Dedicated server mode
settings.summary: Whether this copy of the game runs as a dedicated server.
settings.details: The game treats this as read-only and sets it itself. The separate dedicated-server program is a different launch path. It is latched.

settings.name: developer
settings.title: Developer mode
settings.summary: Turns on developer printing and testing functions.
settings.details: From 0 to 2, and 0 for normal play. CoD2x forces 2 during demo playback only. It is not saved.

settings.name: developer_script
settings.title: Script developer output
settings.summary: Prints debug output from game scripts.
settings.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here.

settings.name: fixedtime
settings.title: Fixed frame time
settings.summary: Forces every frame to last a fixed number of milliseconds.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. 0 is off. zPAM sets it to 0 for every player.

settings.name: friction
settings.title: Ground friction
settings.summary: How quickly you lose speed on the ground.
settings.details: The game protects this setting and the server's value is shared with every player, so it is not a player setting. The default is 5.5. zPAM sets it to 5.5 for every player.

settings.name: fs_basegame
settings.title: Base game folder
settings.summary: The base game folder name.
settings.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

settings.name: fs_basepath
settings.title: Install folder
settings.summary: The folder that contains the game's main folder.
settings.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

settings.name: fs_cdpath
settings.title: CD folder
settings.summary: A folder the game can read files from, as if from a disc.
settings.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

settings.name: fs_copyfiles
settings.title: Copy from CD folder
settings.summary: A Quake 3 style flag to copy files from the CD folder.
settings.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

settings.name: fs_debug
settings.title: File system debug
settings.summary: A developer switch for file system debugging.
settings.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here. It runs from 0 to 2.

settings.name: fs_game
settings.title: Mod folder
settings.summary: The mod folder the game is using.
settings.details: The server shares it with players and the game protects it from changes here. CoD2x resets it to empty and restarts the file system when you leave a server.

settings.name: fs_homepath
settings.title: Game data folder
settings.summary: The folder where the game writes configs, demos, screenshots and logs.
settings.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

settings.name: fs_ignoreLocalized
settings.title: Ignore localized files
settings.summary: A switch the game registers to ignore localized files.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It is latched.

settings.name: fs_restrict
settings.title: Restrict file access
settings.summary: A switch the game registers to restrict file access.
settings.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

settings.name: fs_useOldAssets
settings.title: Use old assets
settings.summary: A switch the game registers to use older asset files.
settings.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here.

settings.name: fx_count
settings.title: Effect counting
settings.summary: A developer switch for counting effects.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: fx_cull
settings.title: Hide unseen effects
settings.summary: Skips drawing effects that are out of view.
settings.details: A culling switch for the effects system. It is on by default and, unlike its neighbours, is not cheat-protected.

settings.name: fx_debug
settings.title: Effects debug
settings.summary: A developer switch that shows effects debugging.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: fx_debugBolt
settings.title: Effects bolt debug
settings.summary: A developer value for debugging bolted-on effects.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: fx_draw
settings.title: Draw effects
settings.summary: Whether the effects system draws its effects.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. ESL's old PunkBuster list required it on.

settings.name: fx_enable
settings.title: Special effects
settings.summary: The master switch for special effects.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. TweakGuide says turning it off can improve performance. ESL's old PunkBuster list and WWCL's old rules required it on.

settings.name: fx_freeze
settings.title: Freeze effects
settings.summary: A developer switch that freezes effects in place.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: fx_profile
settings.title: Effects profiling
settings.summary: A developer switch for profiling effects.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: fx_sort
settings.title: Sort visual effects
settings.summary: Draws overlapping smoke and other effects in depth order.
settings.details: On by default. A PunkBuster kick message read 'Must be equal to 1', ESL's old list required 1, and ePAM, zPAM and CoD2x competitive rules force it on. Only WWCL's 2007 LAN rules asked for 0.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

settings.name: fx_visMinTraceDist
settings.title: Effect visibility distance
settings.summary: A developer distance value for effect visibility checks.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: g_allowVote
settings.title: Allow voting
settings.summary: Lets players call votes on a server you host.
settings.details: The game's Create Server menu has an Allow Voting switch for this. The game scripts decide which votes exist.

settings.name: g_antilag
settings.title: Lag compensation
settings.summary: Rewinds players when you fire so hits land where you saw them, on a server you host.
settings.details: On by default. Rule sets differ: FPSChallenge's EU text and zPAM's EU rules want it off, and zPAM's NA rules want it on. It only matters on a server you host.

settings.name: g_banIPs
settings.title: Banned addresses
settings.summary: The list of banned addresses for a server you host.
settings.details: Saved with your config. It only matters on a server you host.

settings.name: g_clonePlayerMaxVelocity
settings.title: Body push speed
settings.summary: A limit on how fast a dead player's body is pushed.
settings.details: The default is 80. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: g_cod2x
settings.title: Server CoD2x level
settings.summary: Which level of CoD2x features the server you are on supports.
settings.details: The server sets this and the game protects it from changes here. 0 means stock CoD2 1.3 behaviour, and CoD2x servers report 6, the current level. Some CoD2x fixes only switch on at certain levels.

settings.name: g_competitive
settings.title: Competitive server rules
settings.summary: Whether the server has switched on CoD2x's competitive rules.
settings.details: The server sets this and the game protects it from changes here. When it is on, your CoD2x game keeps the frame rate cap between 125 and 250, connection speed at 25,000, updates you receive at 40, updates you send at 125, shadows off, effect sorting on and the sound file system on, and it blocks the wait command once you are connected. zPAM 4's code turns it on in every mode, including public games. Your game turns it off again when you disconnect.

settings.name: g_deadChat
settings.title: Dead players chat
settings.summary: Lets dead players chat with the living on a server you host.
settings.details: Off by default. zPAM registers its own default of on.

settings.name: g_debugBullets
settings.title: Bullet debug level
settings.summary: A developer switch for bullet debugging.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from -3 to 6.

settings.name: g_debugDamage
settings.title: Damage debug
settings.summary: A developer switch for damage debugging.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: g_debugLocDamage
settings.title: Hit location debug
settings.summary: A developer switch for hit-location damage debugging.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: g_dropForwardSpeed
settings.title: Weapon drop forward speed
settings.summary: A tuning value for how dropped weapons fly out.
settings.details: The default is 10. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: g_dropUpSpeedBase
settings.title: Weapon drop up speed
settings.summary: A tuning value for how dropped weapons fly out.
settings.details: The default is 10. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: g_dropUpSpeedRand
settings.title: Weapon drop up variation
settings.summary: A tuning value for how dropped weapons fly out.
settings.details: The default is 5. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: g_dumpAnims
settings.title: Server animation dump
settings.summary: A developer switch that dumps an entity's animations.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

settings.name: g_friendlyfireDist
settings.title: Friendly-fire distance
settings.summary: A distance used for friendly-fire handling.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 256.

settings.name: g_friendlyNameDist
settings.title: Friendly name distance
settings.summary: How far away a friendly player's name shows.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 15,000.

settings.name: g_gametype
settings.title: Game type
settings.summary: Which game type a server you host runs.
settings.details: Stock choices are ctf, dm, hq, sd and tdm, and zPAM adds htf, re and strat. A change applies from the next map because it is latched. It only matters on a server you host.

settings.name: g_gravity
settings.title: Server gravity
settings.summary: How strongly gravity pulls on a server you host.
settings.details: The default is 800 game units per second squared. It only matters on a server you host.

settings.name: g_inactivity
settings.title: Idle kick time
settings.summary: Drops players who are idle this many seconds on a server you host; 0 is off.
settings.details: The server warns them 10 seconds before. The local player is exempt.

settings.name: g_knockback
settings.title: Hit knockback
settings.summary: How hard hits push players back on a server you host.
settings.details: The default is 1,000, and zPAM sets it to 0. It only matters on a server you host.

settings.name: g_listEntity
settings.title: List entities
settings.summary: A developer switch that lists the server's entities.
settings.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here.

settings.name: g_log
settings.title: Game log file
settings.summary: The file a server you host writes its game log to.
settings.details: The default is the standard game log name. It only matters on a server you host.

settings.name: g_logSync
settings.title: Log immediately
settings.summary: Writes the game log straight to disk instead of buffering it.
settings.details: Off by default. It only matters on a server you host.

settings.name: g_mantleBlockTimeBuffer
settings.title: Mantle block time
settings.summary: A server mantle block timer.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 500 milliseconds.

settings.name: g_maxDroppedWeapons
settings.title: Dropped weapon limit
settings.summary: The most dropped weapons left lying around on a server you host.
settings.details: From 1 to 32, and 16 by default.

settings.name: g_motd
settings.title: Hosted server message
settings.summary: A message of the day for a server you host.
settings.details: It only matters on a server you host. The default is empty.

settings.name: g_no_script_spam
settings.title: Limit script spam
settings.summary: A switch the game registers to limit script message spam.
settings.details: Off by default. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: g_oldVoting
settings.title: Old voting system
settings.summary: Uses the older voting system on a server you host.
settings.details: On by default. zPAM's comment says it must stay on or voting does not work.

settings.name: g_password
settings.title: Hosted server password
settings.summary: The password players need to join a server you host.
settings.details: It appears as Password in the game's Create Server menu, which takes up to 12 characters.

settings.name: g_playerCollisionEjectSpeed
settings.title: Player push-apart speed
settings.summary: How fast overlapping players are pushed apart.
settings.details: From 0 to 32,000, and 25 by default. It only matters on a server you host.

settings.name: g_ScoresBanner_Allies
settings.title: Allies scoreboard banner
settings.summary: The scoreboard banner image for the Allies.
settings.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

settings.name: g_ScoresBanner_Axis
settings.title: Axis scoreboard banner
settings.summary: The scoreboard banner image for the Axis.
settings.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

settings.name: g_ScoresBanner_None
settings.title: Neutral scoreboard banner
settings.summary: The scoreboard banner image for no team.
settings.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player.

settings.name: g_ScoresBanner_Spectators
settings.title: Spectator scoreboard banner
settings.summary: The scoreboard banner image for spectators.
settings.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player.

settings.name: g_shotgun_spread_fix
settings.title: Fixed shotgun pattern
settings.summary: Uses a fixed eight-pellet pattern for shotguns instead of random spread.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. CoD2x only. The server picks one of two fixed patterns for each shot.

settings.name: g_smoothClients
settings.title: Smooth other players
settings.summary: Smooths other players' movement on a server you host.
settings.details: On by default. The server extrapolates players' positions before it sends updates.

settings.name: g_speed
settings.title: Player run speed
settings.summary: How fast players run on a server you host.
settings.details: The default is 190 game units per second. It only matters on a server you host.

settings.name: g_synchronousClients
settings.title: Synchronous player logic
settings.summary: Runs each player's logic once per server frame, which smooths demos.
settings.details: Off by default. The server shares it with every player.

settings.name: g_TeamColor_Allies
settings.title: Allies team colour
settings.summary: The colour used for the Allies.
settings.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

settings.name: g_TeamColor_Axis
settings.title: Axis team colour
settings.summary: The colour used for the Axis.
settings.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

settings.name: g_TeamName_Allies
settings.title: Allies team name
settings.summary: The name shown for the Allies.
settings.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

settings.name: g_TeamName_Axis
settings.title: Axis team name
settings.summary: The name shown for the Axis.
settings.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

settings.name: g_useholdspawndelay
settings.title: Spawn use delay
settings.summary: A server delay, in seconds, before players can use things after spawning.
settings.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 1.

settings.name: g_useholdtime
settings.title: Use-key hold time
settings.summary: How long a player must hold the use key.
settings.details: The default is 0. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: g_voiceChatTalkingDuration
settings.title: Voice talking time
settings.summary: How long a player is shown as talking after they speak.
settings.details: From 0 to 10,000, and 500 by default. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: g_voteAbstainWeight
settings.title: Abstain vote weight
settings.summary: How much a player who does not vote counts toward a vote.
settings.details: From 0 to 1, and 0.5 by default. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: g_weaponAmmoPools
settings.title: Shared ammo pools
settings.summary: A switch the game registers for sharing weapon ammo.
settings.details: Off by default. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

settings.name: gamedate
settings.title: Game build date
settings.summary: The date the game was built.
settings.details: The game treats this as read-only and sets it itself.

settings.name: gamename
settings.title: Game name
settings.summary: The name of the game.
settings.details: The game treats this as read-only and sets it itself. The server shares it with players.

settings.name: hud_deathQuoteFadeTime
settings.title: Death quote fade time
settings.summary: How many milliseconds the death quote takes to fade.
settings.details: From 0 to 100,000 milliseconds, and 1,000 by default.

settings.name: hud_enable
settings.title: Show the HUD
settings.summary: Shows or hides the heads-up display.
settings.details: The game's menu calls this Draw HUD. Turning it off hides the HUD menus the game draws on top of the picture. Game state still decides which elements appear while it is on.

settings.name: hud_fade_ammodisplay
settings.title: Ammo display fade
settings.summary: How many seconds before the ammo display fades; 0 keeps it visible.
settings.details: From 0 to 30 seconds.

settings.name: hud_fade_compass
settings.title: Compass fade
settings.summary: How many seconds before the compass fades.
settings.details: From 0 to 30 seconds.

settings.name: hud_fade_healthbar
settings.title: Health bar fade
settings.summary: How many seconds before the health bar fades.
settings.details: From 0 to 30 seconds.

settings.name: hud_fade_offhand
settings.title: Grenade display fade
settings.summary: How many seconds before the grenade display fades.
settings.details: From 0 to 30 seconds.

settings.name: hud_fade_stance
settings.title: Stance display fade
settings.summary: How many seconds before the stance display fades.
settings.details: From 0 to 30 seconds.

settings.name: hud_fadeout_speed
settings.title: HUD fade speed
settings.summary: How fast faded HUD elements disappear.
settings.details: From 0 to 1, and 0.1 by default.

settings.name: hud_flash_period_offhand
settings.title: Grenade flash period
settings.summary: How many seconds between flashes of the grenade display.

settings.name: hud_flash_time_offhand
settings.title: Grenade flash time
settings.summary: How many seconds the grenade display flashes.
settings.details: From 0 to 30 seconds, and 2 by default.

settings.name: hud_health_pulserate_critical
settings.title: Critical health pulse
settings.summary: How fast the health display pulses when you are badly hurt.
settings.details: From 0.1 to 3, and 0.5 by default.

settings.name: hud_health_pulserate_injured
settings.title: Injured health pulse
settings.summary: How fast the health display pulses when you are hurt.
settings.details: From 0.1 to 3, and 1 by default.

settings.name: hud_health_startpulse_critical
settings.title: Critical pulse starts
settings.summary: The health level where the critical pulse starts.
settings.details: A fraction of full health from 0 to 1.1, and 0.33 by default.

settings.name: hud_health_startpulse_injured
settings.title: Injured pulse starts
settings.summary: The health level where the injured pulse starts.
settings.details: A fraction of full health from 0 to 1.1, and 1 by default.

settings.name: hud_healthOverlay_phaseEnd_pulseDuration
settings.title: Health overlay end pulse

settings.name: m_pitch

settings.details: The default, 0.022, tilts the normal way, and the game's own Invert Mouse option writes -0.022. settings.name: m_rinput_hz
